title: solidago uliginosa var. terrae-novae
intro: Solidago uliginosa var. terrae-novae, commonly known as Newfoundland goldenrod, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to the eastern parts of Canada and the United States. The Newfoundland goldenrod has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing oxidative stress and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Newfoundland goldenrod include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
